title: 第1章 邻座的冰山美女！
content_zh:
“十年了，不知道那些令人讨厌的家伙，到底怎么样了！”

坐在飞往华夏的飞机上，叶乘风看着窗外那美丽的风景，唇角却不自觉地勾起一抹浅浅的坏笑。

还记得，当初离开华夏的时候，叶乘风只是一个十五岁的稚嫩少年。

而今十年之后，当初的少年已经长大，蜕变成了一个铁骨铮铮的男人。

一名性感美丽的空姐，微微笑着问道。

空姐将目光，转移到叶乘风身边的人。

这是一位，身着银灰色修身连衣短裙的女子。

她酒红秀发披肩，明眸皓齿间透着一股颠倒众生的美丽。

精致的五官，与那高耸的胸脯，性感的***，还有那纤细修长的美腿搭配，简直美若天赐，只一眼便能叫人难以忘怀。

饶是那姿色极好的空姐，都暗暗有些自惭形秽了起来。

目光下移之下，空姐又看到那女子美腿上的黑色丝袜，以及脚下那双完全包住小腿的白色长筒软靴，竟不由自主地生出一种想要与那女子亲热的念头来。

那女子，目不转睛地盯着手上的一份杂志。

音如天籁，却冰冷异常，让人感觉如同遭遇了一阵寒流，冷得几欲哆嗦。

自他上了这架飞机，就注意到了这个堪称极品的邻座美女。

但旅程过去了大半，他却始终没听那美女讲过一句话，更没有机会与之搭讪。

然而，尽管是现在有了机会，叶乘风却依然没有成功。

竟是那冷冰冰的美女，在拿了咖啡之后，理都没有理他，只是自顾地看着杂志，眉头不皱地喝着苦咖啡。

“好吧，原来是一座爱喝苦咖啡的冰山。”

叶乘风耸了耸肩，却也没有无礼纠缠。

那极品美女虽然动人，但却冷若冰霜，他才不想热脸贴那冷屁股。

“呵，就这穷酸模样，还想搭讪美女。”

叶乘风前面位置的一名棕色西装男人，非常小声的嘀咕了一句，但却被叶乘风丝毫不落地听入了耳中。

叶乘风正待发作，却忽然听见后方，传来了一声大喝：“全都不许动，劫机！”

只看见，十二名持着微型手枪的蒙面男子，杀气腾腾地从机尾冲了过来。

其中一人的手中，还拽着一名被打得满头是血的空警。

跟着下一秒，受伤的空警就被丢在地上，那十二名蒙面男子十分有序地留下四人镇守机舱，其余八人则往飞机驾驶舱疾驰而去，显然是要控制机长一类的人。

这一幕惊变，着实吓得许多人都脸色发白。

纵然是叶乘风身边的那位冰山美女，也有些手抖，以至咖啡洒落。

而刚才，说叶乘风穷酸的那棕色西装男子，则更是不堪，居然浑身发抖。

倒是叶乘风，此刻仍然是一副风轻云淡的姿态，仿佛眼下所发生的一切都与他无关似的。

略微过了一会儿，飞机驾驶舱便出来了四名蒙面男子。

其中一名为首的高个蒙面男子，举着微型手枪，扫视机舱内的所有人，操着一腔倭国口音很重的华夏语说道：“我们是来自真理教的，今天劫机只想与华夏官方谈判，要求释放我们的重要高层，不求财，也不想伤害任何人。”

说完，他就枪口对着机舱顶部连开了三枪。

刺耳的枪声，吓得机上乘客一阵尖叫。

那为首的高个蒙面男子，满意地点了点头后，才接着道：“希望大家配合，不要反抗，更别想在私底下做什么小动作！否则，我们可不保证在与华夏官方谈判之前，就先杀上几个！”

之前说叶乘风穷酸的棕色西装男子，忙举起双手，哆嗦大叫：“我……我是企业老板，我……我可以给你们很多钱，求你们……放了我！”

为首那高个蒙面男子一听，直接走过去把那棕色西装男子拽了出来。

枪托一砸，那棕色西装男子顿时惨叫着倒地，满头是血，竟是当场被吓尿了，霎时一股尿骚味道在机舱内蔓延开来，惹得叶乘风险些笑喷。

不过，为首那高个蒙面男子的举动，却让飞机上的乘客们惊恐地意识到，刚才的话一点儿也没有掺假成分。

众所周知，真理教是一个起源于倭国的世界恐怖组织，擅长使用毒气制造恐怖。

而且前阵子，华夏官方新闻确实发布过通告，表示抓捕了一名真理教高层。

如此一来，眼下这帮真理教****，还真就打算拿飞机上的乘客与华夏官方谈判。

为首那高个蒙面男子，见乘客们惶恐不已，便得意地笑出了声：“为了保证谈判顺利，这趟飞往华夏的飞机，需要改变航线，大家不必惊慌，待到谈判成功之后，我们自会放人。”

话才刚刚说完，叶乘风便感觉飞机倾斜，在高空转了个方向，显然是驾驶舱里的四名真理教****，逼迫驾驶员改变了飞行方向。

略微一顿，驾驶舱内出来了一名矮胖男人，他急不可耐地扫了扫那蹲在一堆的空姐，随后瞟向了叶乘风身旁那位冰山美女，几乎是不自觉地咽了一口口水。

跟着，便用倭国语和那为首的高个男人说了一通。

叶乘风通晓十几门外语，对于倭国语言自然不在话下。

他知道，那矮胖男人其实看上了他身边的冰山美女，要求现在就带去卫生间强行占有。

而为首的高个男人，则表示谈判没有开始，不能随意伤害机上乘客。

但那矮胖男人却说，几个月没碰女人，今天突然遇见了这么一个火辣辣的极品美女，根本忍不住，到时候出了什么问题会一力承担。

于是最终，为首的高个男人只得点头。

矮胖男人兴奋地舔了舔下唇，微型手枪对着叶乘风身旁那位冰山美女指了指，示意她从座位起来。

“你……你们说过不伤害乘客的。”

冰山美女似乎懂几分倭国语，此刻一脸的惨白，原本迷人的双眸中，满是惊恐之色。

不知道是想寻求一个依靠，还是她看出了叶乘风的不凡，竟不由自主地抓住了叶乘风的一条手臂，惊恐美眸中透着一丝渴求。

“哥哥只想带你去品尝品尝那销魂蚀骨的滋味儿，怎么能叫伤害呢？说不定你会为此着迷的，嘿嘿。”

矮胖男人就差没流口水了，吓得那冰山美女越发紧抓叶乘风的手臂。

甚至，冰山美女的指甲，都好像要刺入叶乘风的肉里一般，显然是被吓怕了。

叶乘风抬脚就揣，当场把那欲拉冰山美女起身的矮胖男人，给踹成了滚地冬瓜。

矮胖男人怒极，举枪就想射杀叶乘风。

同时，机舱内的其他蒙面男子，也纷纷持枪上前，黑洞洞的枪口直接把叶乘风给包围了。

（新书上传，喜欢的收藏和鲜花支持哈。）
content_en:
"It's been ten years, I wonder what happened to those annoying guys!"

Sitting on the plane flying to China, Ye Chengfeng looked at the beautiful scenery outside the window, but the corners of his lips unconsciously raised a faint smile.

I still remember that when he left China, Ye Chengfeng was just a fifteen-year-old boy.

Now ten years later, the boy has grown up and transformed into a strong-willed man.

A sexy and beautiful stewardess asked with a slight smile.

The flight attendant turned her attention to the people around Ye Chengfeng.

This is a woman wearing a silver-grey slim-fitting short dress.

Her burgundy hair is shawl-shaped, and her bright eyes and white teeth reveal a beauty that captivates all living beings.

The exquisite facial features, paired with the towering breasts, sexy breasts, and slender legs, are simply as beautiful as a gift from heaven, and can be unforgettable with just one glance.

Even the very pretty stewardess was secretly ashamed of herself.

Looking down, the stewardess saw the black stockings on the woman's beautiful legs and the pair of white soft boots that completely covered her calves. She couldn't help but have the idea of ​​being intimate with the woman.

The woman stared intently at a magazine in her hand.

The sound is like the sound of nature, but it is extremely cold, making people feel as if they have encountered a cold wave, making them shiver with coldness.

Ever since he got on the plane, he had noticed the absolutely stunning beauty sitting next to him.

But more than half of the journey passed, but he never heard a word from the beautiful woman, let alone had a chance to strike up a conversation with her.

However, even though he now had the opportunity, Ye Chengfeng still failed.

It was the cold beauty who ignored him after getting the coffee. She just looked at the magazine and drank the bitter coffee without frowning.

"Well, it turns out to be an iceberg that loves bitter coffee."

Ye Chengfeng shrugged, but did not pester him rudely.

Although that top beauty was attractive, she was as cold as ice. He didn't want to put his hot face against that cold ass.

"Ha, you look so poor and want to chat with a beautiful woman."

A man in a brown suit in front of Ye Chengfeng muttered something very quietly, but Ye Chengfeng heard it without missing a beat.

Ye Chengfeng was about to have an attack, but suddenly he heard a loud shout from behind: "No one is allowed to move, the plane is hijacked!"

All he saw was twelve masked men holding miniature pistols rushing over from the tail of the plane with murderous intent.

In the hands of one of them, he was holding an air marshal who was beaten with blood on his head.

The next second, the injured air marshal was thrown to the ground. The twelve masked men left four to guard the cabin in an orderly manner, while the remaining eight rushed towards the cockpit of the aircraft, obviously to control people like the captain.

This scene was so shocking that many people turned pale with fright.

Even the iceberg beauty next to Ye Chengfeng had some shaking hands and even spilled her coffee.

And just now, the man in brown suit who said Ye Chengfeng was poor was even more unbearable and was actually trembling all over.

Ye Chengfeng, on the other hand, still had a calm and indifferent attitude at this moment, as if everything happening now had nothing to do with him.

After a while, four masked men came out of the cockpit of the aircraft.

One of the leaders, a tall masked man, held up a miniature pistol, glanced at everyone in the cabin, and spoke in Chinese with a heavy Japanese accent: "We are from the Truth Religion. Today's hijacking only wants to negotiate with Chinese officials and demand the release of our important senior officials. We are not seeking money, and we do not want to harm anyone."

After saying that, he fired three shots at the top of the cabin.

The piercing sound of gunfire scared the passengers on board and screamed.

The tall masked man at the head nodded with satisfaction, and then continued: "I hope everyone will cooperate and not resist, let alone make any small moves in private! Otherwise, we cannot guarantee that we will kill a few before negotiating with the Chinese officials!"

The man in a brown suit who had previously said that Ye Chengfeng was poor quickly raised his hands and shouted tremblingly: "I...I am the owner of a company, I...I can give you a lot of money, please...let me go!"

Upon hearing this, the tall masked man at the head walked over and pulled the man in the brown suit out.

As soon as the butt of the gun was smashed, the man in the brown suit screamed and fell to the ground. His head was covered with blood. He was so frightened that he peed on the spot. The smell of urine spread in the cabin, making Ye Chengjian burst out laughing.

However, the actions of the tall masked man in the lead made the passengers on the plane realize in horror that what they just said was not adulterated at all.

As we all know, the Shinrikyo is a world terrorist organization that originated from Japan and is good at using poison gas to create terror.

Moreover, a while ago, China's official news did issue an announcement stating that a senior member of the Truth Religion had been arrested.

As a result, these truth cult **** are really planning to use the passengers on the plane to negotiate with Chinese officials.

The tall masked man at the head, seeing the panic among the passengers, laughed triumphantly: "In order to ensure the smooth progress of the negotiations, the flight to China needs to change its route. Don't panic. We will release them after the negotiations are successful."

As soon as he finished speaking, Ye Chengfeng felt the plane tilt and turn at a high altitude. It was obviously the four Shinrikyo terrorists in the cockpit who forced the pilot to change the direction of flight.

After a brief pause, a short and fat man came out of the cockpit. He glanced impatiently at the squatting stewardess, then glanced at the iceberg beauty next to Ye Chengfeng, and swallowed almost unconsciously.

Then, he spoke to the tall man in Japanese language.

Ye Chengfeng is proficient in more than a dozen foreign languages, and he is naturally familiar with the Japanese language.

He knew that the short and fat man actually fell in love with the iceberg beauty next to him and asked to take her to the bathroom and take her by force right now.

The tall man in the lead said that the negotiations had not started and that passengers on the plane could not be harmed at will.

But the short and fat man said that he had not touched a woman for several months, and today he suddenly met such a hot and beautiful woman. He couldn't help it at all, and he would bear the responsibility if anything went wrong.

So in the end, the tall man at the head had no choice but to nod.

The short and fat man licked his lower lip excitedly, pointed the miniature pistol at the iceberg beauty next to Ye Chengfeng, and motioned for her to get up from her seat.

"You...you promised not to harm passengers."

The Bingshan beauty seemed to understand some Japanese language. Her face was pale at the moment, and her originally charming eyes were full of fear.

She didn't know whether it was because she wanted to seek support, or because she saw how extraordinary Ye Chengfeng was, so she couldn't help but grab one of Ye Chengfeng's arms, with a trace of longing in her frightened beautiful eyes.

"Brother just wants to take you to taste the soul-crushing taste. How can you call it hurt? Maybe you will be fascinated by it, hehe."

The pudgy man was almost drooling, and the iceberg beauty was so frightened that she clung to Ye Chengfeng's arm even more tightly.

Even the nails of the iceberg beauty seemed to be piercing into Ye Chengfeng's flesh. She was obviously frightened.

Ye Chengfeng raised his foot and kicked the short, fat man who was trying to pull the iceberg beauty to a pulp on the spot.

The short and fat man was so angry that he raised his gun and wanted to shoot Ye Chengfeng.

At the same time, other masked men in the cabin also came forward with guns, and the black muzzles directly surrounded Ye Chengfeng.
